entries.camera: Deck-level wide shot with a heavy dutch tilt, the horizon canted about twenty degrees, wide lens, spray frozen in the air.
entries.subject: A hooded figure seen from behind at the bow of a ship in a violent storm, one fist raising a heavy flanged mace overhead. A fork of lightning is caught in the act of leaping from a black cloud into the mace head, lighting the mast and rigging white, while a ring of thunderous shockwave tears the spray off the waves around the bow. Giant dark waves tower on both sides and the wet deck is tilted by the swell.
entries.accent: storm slate with electric white-blue lightning

entries.camera: Telephoto compressed view from behind and slightly to one side of a battle line, long lens, rows of figures stacked closely in depth.
entries.subject: A war-priest in dented plate armour, seen from behind, holds a heavy flanged mace high in front of a wall of locked iron shields. Above the line a colossal spectral warhammer made of bronze light hangs in the smoky sky, its shadow falling across the shields, which glow along their rims with the blessing of the war god. The ground ahead cracks and throws up a ring of dust where the light lands. Plain unmarked banners snap in the wind.

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, perfectly symmetrical, wide lens, the figure small at the exact centre of the frame.
entries.subject: Looking straight down into a round white-stone hospice courtyard, a cleric in pale robes with the hood up kneels at the centre of a floor mosaic, cupped hands held low. From the hands a ring of warm light spreads outward across the paving, and a circle of flowerbeds and small trees around the edge bursts into bloom at the moment the ring reaches them, petals and glowing motes spiralling up toward the camera.

entries.camera: Side-on close-up still life at desk level, 70mm look, shallow depth of field, the glass sphere in sharp focus.
entries.subject: On a scholar's oak desk in a lamplit study, a large clear crystal sphere on a brass stand holds a tiny drifting vision of an ancient city, whose sepia light escapes the glass as floating motes. Around it: a stack of leather-bound books with blank spines, an open tome whose pages show only abstract circles and star diagrams with no writing, an hourglass, a brass magnifying lens on a chain and a guttering candle. Towering bookshelves fade into darkness behind.
entries.accent: deep indigo-blue with warm brass lamplight

entries.camera: Extreme macro close-up at anvil height, 100mm look, razor-thin depth of field, sparks frozen mid-air.
entries.subject: A heavy hammer comes down on a glowing sword blank held on an anvil by long tongs, caught at the instant of impact: a fan of orange sparks explodes across the frame and the blank pulses with a pattern of abstract, non-legible glowing veins that crawl up from the strike. Only two forearms in thick soot-blackened leather gauntlets are visible, cropped at the elbows. Behind, the blurred orange mouth of a furnace and racks of unfinished armour.

entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind a robed shoulder and raised forearm in the dark foreground, medium-wide, the spell in sharp focus beyond.
entries.subject: In the foreground, only the dark robed shoulder and raised open hand of a cleric, cropped, no face. Ahead, a huge unstable sphere of violet spell energy ringed by a spinning band of abstract, non-legible glyph shapes rushes toward the hand. The palm throws up a lattice of pale hexagonal panes, and where the sphere touches the lattice it unravels into harmless ribbons of coloured light that stream away in curls on both sides.

entries.camera: Extreme high-angle wide shot from a distant hillside, two tiny figures, enormous depth, soft morning haze.
entries.subject: Two tiny silhouetted figures stand side by side on a stone footbridge over a calm river in a sunlit valley, seen from far above. A slender glowing cord of light is woven between their raised hands and widens into a soft ring around them, petals drifting inside it. On both banks, rows of planted spears and set-down shields stand abandoned in the long grass, wildflowers climbing their shafts. Pale mist lies along the water.

entries.camera: Static eye-level wide shot through the bars of an iron cemetery gate, the bars soft and dark in the foreground, thin ground fog.
entries.subject: A tall cloaked gravekeeper seen from behind stands at the threshold of an open stone crypt door set into a hillside, one hand holding a lantern, the other flat against the door's edge as if keeping it from swinging wider. Pale spectral light and curling mist pour out of the doorway around the figure's feet. Rows of weathered headstones with nothing carved on them recede into the fog, and a spade stands upright in the soil nearby.
entries.accent: pale ghost-green lantern light on charcoal

entries.camera: Peeking shot past the edge of a heavy velvet curtain in the dark foreground, medium-wide, the checkerboard floor in sharp focus.
entries.subject: In a moonlit ballroom with a black-and-white checkerboard floor, two identical hooded figures in long cloaks, both seen from behind, walk away in opposite directions. One of them is a translucent shimmering illusion that leaves a trail of drifting sparkles, the other is the real one slipping toward a gap behind a curtain. Rows of tall stone statues look on, and the long mirrors on the walls show the two figures in different poses.

entries.camera: Symmetrical low-angle frontal shot from floor level at the foot of a wide marble staircase, strong converging lines, wide lens.
entries.subject: At the top of a vast marble staircase in a colonnaded hall, a figure in an imperial scarlet robe seen from behind raises one hand in a halting gesture. A perfect ring of light races out from the hand and across the floor, and on the steps below it a scatter of dropped swords, shields and torches lies still. Rows of identical pillars and rows of identical lamps repeat to the far end of the hall.

entries.camera: Long-lens eye-level shot through out-of-focus leaves in the foreground, shallow depth of field, backlit by low golden sun.
entries.subject: A great antlered stag stands calmly in a sunlit forest clearing, its antlers grown into living branches heavy with leaves and blossoms, vines and wildflowers curling up its legs from the ground. In the lower corner a robed figure seen from behind kneels with one palm flat on the moss, golden pollen drifting up from it. A fox, an owl on a low branch and a few rabbits watch quietly from the edge of the clearing.
entries.accent: deep forest green with golden pollen light

entries.camera: Backlit silhouette shot from behind at waist height looking straight into the light, strong lens flare, the figure a black cutout.
entries.subject: In the middle of a vast pitch-black vault, a small silhouetted figure seen from behind raises one hand. A blinding corona of light blooms from the palm into a sunburst ring with long straight rays, tearing the heavy black fog into ribbons of smoke and throwing long shadows of the pillars across the floor. The light reveals carved walls and hidden statues that no eye has seen for centuries.

entries.camera: Tight foreground shot over the curved edge of a scythe blade, 100mm look, very shallow depth of field, the hooded figure blurred behind.
entries.subject: In the sharp foreground, the long curved blade of a black scythe, its edge outlined by a thin line of sickly acid-yellow necrotic light, a drift of grey ash sliding off it. Behind it, out of focus, a tall hooded silhouette with only a black void inside the hood stands on a plain of pale ash where withered wheat and bare dead trees crumble to dust. A cold bone-white moon hangs low, the base of the blade carved with small skull motifs.
entries.accent: ash black and bone white with sickly acid-yellow

entries.camera: Ultra-wide ground-level shot tilted up at the night sky, camera resting on the grass, long-exposure star trails above the dome.
entries.subject: A faintly glowing hemisphere of twilight stands over a tiny campsite on a dark moor, its soft wall full of drifting stars and slow motes of light. Inside it, a few tents, a banked campfire and bedrolls lie calm and still. A lone silhouetted watcher sits on a rock at the edge of the dome with a small lantern, looking out into the night while the sky above turns from amber at the horizon to deep dusk.
entries.accent: lavender dusk with a thin amber horizon
